mechanism: Betamethasone may increase clonazepam metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing benzodiazepine efficacy, while both drugs can cause CNS depression and immunosuppression.
action: Monitor clonazepam efficacy and CNS effects; consider dose adjustment of clonazepam if betamethasone therapy is initiated or discontinued; use caution with concurrent CNS depressants.
